meeting_scene:
As Sam walked into the conference room, he took his usual seat at the far end of the table and waited for everyone else to arrive before speaking up first. "Just wanted to share something with you all," he said quietly after Priya began discussing a new project deadline that was looming on their collective horizon - an impending team meeting next week where they'd have to present updates, but no one seemed too concerned about it yet.

Alex cleared throat and jumped in immediately as well, stating "That reminds me of some great news: our product redesign received positive feedback from key clients yesterday!" Their words lit up the room with excitement. Meanwhile Jordan leaned back into his chair while nodding along - an expression betraying a lingering headache that he'd been too busy working on several other fronts to tackle properly in weeks.
